name: zalo-whatsapp-crm-standalone
description: Standalone Omnichannel Zalo & WhatsApp CRM (Frontend + Backend)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: sh -c 'npm --prefix backend run dev & npm --prefix frontend run dev & wait'
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
